description: Reads 1-10 company websites (homepage plus about/contact pages) and returns per domain: company and legal name, description, industry guess, address when published, founded year and stated employee count when published, logo, company social pages (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub), detected website technologies and language. No email addresses or phone numbers. Billed per profile returned.

domains.description: 1-10 company domains or website URLs, e.g. stripe.com or https://www.notion.so.

pages_per_domain.description: 1 = homepage only (fastest); 3 = + about and contact pages (default); 4 adds the imprint page; 5 also tries /company.

name: company_profile
title: Company profile from its website
